description: A tappable milestone row inside a plan card. Toggles reached/pending on press with an optimistic in-flight spinner. Leading status icon, title (strikethrough when reached), subtitle showing reached/target date, and an optional partner glyph.

targetDate.description: ISO date — shown as 'Target {short date}' when pending.

reachedAt.description: ISO date — shown as 'Reached {short date}' when reached.

toggling.description: In-flight update; swaps the status icon for an ActivityIndicator.

partner.description: { glyph: '◑'|'◐', color, name } — optional attribution glyph; omit for shared/unknown.

accessibility.label: {title}, {status === 'reached' ? 'reached' : 'pending'}, {reached ? 'reached ' + reachedAt : 'target ' + targetDate}{, by {partner.name}}.
accessibility.colorIndependence: Reached vs pending conveyed by filled vs outline icon + strikethrough + 'Reached' vs 'Target' word, never color alone.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Instant icon swap on toggle; no scale animation.
